title: A 3-element Yagi on 10m, then a doublet at 5 W
when: 23 Oct 2025 · Big Spring State Park (POTA US-2989)
antenna: 3-element Yagi on 10m at 75 W, then a doublet at 5 W, CW
blurb: One day, two setups: 140 contacts on 10m with the Yagi at 75 W (13:47 to 16:51 UTC, 79 of them with Europe), then I put up a doublet and ran 5 watts, 141 contacts from 17:56 to 20:55 UTC, mostly on 20m, 15m and 12m. The estimates use 75 W before 17:00 UTC and 5 W after.

title: A SOTA summit with a KX2 and an EFHW
when: 31 Mar 2026 · W5T/GU-018, Guadalupe Mountains National Park
antenna: KX2 at 5 W, CW; EFHW with a homebrew MM0OPX-style winding, built on a circuit board MM0OPX designed for QRP
blurb: The second activation of this unnamed summit, and the biggest: 91 contacts on 10m, 15m and 20m, with Europe on 10m in the first half hour.

title: A homebrew EFHW, inverted L, 100 W
when: 28 Nov 2025 (Black Friday) · Big Spring State Park (POTA US-2989)
antenna: Homebrew EFHW, MM0OPX winding, as an inverted L, 100 W, CW
blurb: 257 contacts from 14:45 to 20:02 UTC on 20m, 15m and 10m, 22 of them with Europe and 13 park to park. Part 3 of a 3 part series on building and testing this antenna.

title: My biggest at Bush House: an OCF whip dipole on homebrew open line
when: 21 Nov 2026 · Bush Family Home State Historic Site (POTA US-10272)
antenna: OCF dipole made of whips, fed with homebrew open-wire line, 75 W, CW
blurb: 179 contacts in three hours, 20:27 to 23:25 UTC, on 20m, 15m, 17m, 12m and 10m, and 69 RBN skimmers heard me. My biggest activation at this park.

title: An activation during a G5 solar storm
when: 11 May 2024 · Bush Family Home State Historic Site (POTA US-10272)
blurb: A quarter-wave vertical in the middle of the G5 geomagnetic storm of May 2024: 24 contacts on 30m and 20m, seven in the morning and seventeen in the afternoon. Open the space weather card to see the storm, the ejections NASA links to it and where the session fell.
